protocol.protocol_note: the plan's screening budget: seed 0 / 5,000 steps / batch 128 / Adam / lr 1e-4 / wd 0 / clip 0.5; extending to 20,000 steps is a separate conditional decision and is not taken in this round

label_semantics.A0: CE on executed_cand — the action the teacher actually executed (source=step_frames). The version plan calls A0's target 'chosen action CE'; on this corpus the without-invention column is the executed one, so A0 trains on it.
label_semantics.A0v: CE on chosen_verified_cand — the engine-verified teacher choice (1-of-18 per slot). This is the plan's 'chosen' measured as a separate, separately named control arm.
label_semantics.rule: the two columns are never merged, averaged or used to fill each other; each arm names the column it trained on

declaration.claim: a 256-slot full-batch overfit shows the corpus, the label and the optimiser can be fitted end to end
declaration.cost_error_reason: this corpus carries no cost label: the bounded-horizon branch cost is produced by T03/WP420-02, which has not run, so reporting a cost error would invent a label
not_proved: 256 slots against 731,802 parameters is memorisation, not learning
the holdout numbers of an overfitted model are reported to show that it does not transfer; they are not a generalisation score
no game metric is measured here: the layer-1 result is not an ability claim and cannot open G420-2
the safe-set rate is measured against T02d's single verified candidate per slot; it is not a full 18-way safety ranking

smoke_run.note: a 20-step smoke run of the same protocol, used only to prove the GPU path, the checkpoint write and the load-back before the 5,000-step run; it is not a result

g420_0_l1.closing_action: the corpus was consumed by a real training run: 5,000 Adam steps x 2 arms over the 80 % train split and a full forward pass over the 20 % holdout
g420_0_l1.verdict: the L1 'consumed' action is executed; the L1 gate verdict itself is the main agent's call, not this file's

limits: this is a controlled learning report, not a capability claim: no game metric is produced by the training run itself
G420-2 is not passed here: A1 needs the engine-truth safe sets of T03 and A2 is a privileged-state diagnostic that does not exist yet
the holdout is an in-corpus split of three training seeds (10/11/12); it is not a clean generalisation set and not a development or confirmation split
the executed and verified targets are different labels (6,288/19,772 slots disagree); every number below names the column it used
a low training CE or a high training top-1 is fitting, not competence
